reason: I already drink YEAHRBA mate and get it cheaper on Rohlík with my normal shop, so paying 55 crowns plus e-shop delivery for basically the same thing makes no sense. Money isn't the issue, paying extra for no clear difference is.
objection: It doesn't say how much sugar is in it. 'Natural lemon and grapefruit concentrate' can still mean sugar, and 'natural' is what every brand says now.
would_change_my_mind: A clear label showing zero or near-zero sugar and no sweeteners, and getting it on Rohlík or at my gym fridge at about the same price as YEAHRBA.
